description: This header file declares internal functions and prototypes for the SLAP Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) Service Proxy Object, including state management, operation handling, and utility conversions.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetCallTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the call timeout value for the SLAP proxy object.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetCallTimeout
methods.description: Sets the call timeout value for the SLAP proxy object.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetObjName
methods.description: Returns the object name of the SLAP proxy object.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetObjName
methods.description: Sets the object name of the SLAP proxy object.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetObjType
methods.description: Returns the object type identifier.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetObjType
methods.description: Sets the object type identifier.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetObjMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the object.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetObjMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of the object.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetSlapGoaObj
methods.description: Retrieves the associated SLAP GOA object handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetSlapGoaObj
methods.description: Assigns a SLAP GOA object handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetSlapUoaIf
methods.description: Gets the SLAP UOA interface handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetSlapUoaIf
methods.description: Sets the SLAP UOA interface handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetSlapGoaIf
methods.description: Gets the SLAP GOA interface handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetSlapGoaIf
methods.description: Sets the SLAP GOA interface handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoGetSlapPoaIf
methods.description: Gets the SLAP POA interface handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoSetSlapPoaIf
methods.description: Sets the SLAP POA interface handle.

methods.name: SlapSpoEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the SLAP proxy object.

methods.name: SlapSpoCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the SLAP proxy object.

methods.name: SlapSpoInvokeDispatch
methods.description: Invokes a method dispatch on the SLAP proxy object with given method name and parameters.

methods.name: SlapSpoPoaToGoaParamList
methods.description: Converts POA parameters to GOA parameter list.

methods.name: SlapSpoGoaToPoaParamList
methods.description: Converts GOA parameters to POA parameter list.

methods.name: SlapSpoPoaToGoaVariable
methods.description: Converts POA variable to GOA variable format.

methods.name: SlapSpoGoaToPoaVariable
methods.description: Converts GOA variable to POA variable format.
